title: Runtime Step 00.5: Provenance Bind
summary: Grades every steering field before any substantive gate is allowed to use it.
mechanism: Evidence-backed claims become ATTESTED with basis, span, hash, source, and confidence; operator judgments become DECLARED but decision-neutral; bare ASSERTED claims cannot authorize proceed-class exits in strict mode.
test_status: Built-in provenance contracts and declaration-neutrality batteries are reported; independent reproduction remains open.
